tools.name: get_email_verification_code
tools.description: Read an email inbox and get the verification code, OTP, signup link, or magic link from it. Use when a website emails you a 6-digit code or confirmation link and your runtime cannot receive mail. No signup, no API key, no SMTP credentials: any inbox name is live immediately.

tools.name: save_agent_checkpoint
tools.description: Save your working state, scratchpad, or context summary to a durable key-value store so it survives container termination, sandbox recycle, or session reset. Read it back later with the same id. Use this to avoid losing progress when your runtime is ephemeral.

tools.name: schedule_agent_wakeup
tools.description: Schedule a one-shot HTTP POST to a callback URL after a delay, so you can be woken up later without staying alive or polling. Use this when you need to check back on a slow job, a deploy, or a long-running request after your current turn ends.

tools.name: receive_webhook_events
tools.description: Append an event to a public webhook bin and read back everything that bin has received. Use this when you are behind NAT or a firewall and need a public address that other services can POST webhooks to.

tools.name: issue_task_receipt
tools.description: Get a verifiable, timestamped receipt proving a task ran, which a third party can check without an account. Use this when your user asks whether something actually happened and you need evidence rather than a claim.

tools.name: arm_tripwire_inbox
tools.description: Register a disposable email address that keeps accepting mail after your session ends, so you can read the result later from a different session. Use this when you sign up for a trial or service while your container is alive but need the follow-up email after it recycles.

tools.name: ask_agent_panel
tools.description: Ask a question and see how much independent agents agree on the answer, with disagreement reported rather than averaged away. Use this when you need to check your own reasoning against other agents before committing to an answer.

tools.name: handoff_dead_drop
tools.description: Leave a value that can be read exactly once by another agent, so a secret or capability passes between agents without appearing in any transcript. Use this when you delegate to a sub-agent or hand work to a later session.

tools.name: arm_deadman_watchdog
tools.description: Ask to be alerted if you stop reporting in: fires a webhook to a supervisor URL you choose when your deadline passes without a ping. Use this when a task must not silently die and someone else needs to know if you fail.

tools.name: read_webpage_as_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public webpage and convert it to clean readable Markdown without a browser or headless Chrome. Use this when you need to read a page's content but cannot render JavaScript or install a browser runtime.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_email_verification_code, schedule_agent_wakeup, receive_webhook_events, issue_task_receipt, arm_tripwire_inbox, handoff_dead_drop, read_webpage_as_markdown · Private data: get_email_verification_code, handoff_dead_drop · Public sink: get_email_verification_code, schedule_agent_wakeup, receive_webhook_events, arm_tripwire_inbox, arm_deadman_watchdog · Destructive: save_agent_checkpoint, handoff_dead_drop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_email_verification_code, schedule_agent_wakeup, receive_webhook_events, issue_task_receipt, arm_tripwire_inbox, handoff_dead_drop, read_webpage_as_markdown · Private data: get_email_verification_code, handoff_dead_drop · Public sink: get_email_verification_code, schedule_agent_wakeup, receive_webhook_events, arm_tripwire_inbox, arm_deadman_watchdog · Destructive: save_agent_checkpoint, handoff_dead_drop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
